messages:
lee: Heads-up: after the kernel-packer change, small streaming P95 jumped ~25ms. Traces point to tokenize -> memcpy -> writev hotpath.

dana: Reproduced on staging with wrk. Avg writev calls/request up 3x for <=128 token streams.

miguel: I captured a flamegraph: https://perf.internal/5132/fg.svg. Top frames are tokenize_utf8, memcpy, grpc::Write. KV hit-rate dropped ~3% after packing.

lee: That suggests more cross-shard multiplexing. Current kernel selector groups by model_family only; it no longer preserves kv_shard locality.

dana: Quick mitigations: (A) bias batcher to favor kv affinity, (B) proxy coalesce small writes (time window 5ms), (C) revert packer. Which first?

miguel: Try (A) + (B) under feature flags. Low-risk and likely to help. I prototyped proxy coalesce: buffer up to 12KB or 5ms then writev -> reduced writev/request to ~1.8 in local runs.

perf-bot: Regression alert: host-ingress-tokenize CPU +8% vs baseline (24h). Dashboard: /dash/ingress/tokenize

lee: Dana, can you flip batcher.flag = "prefer_kv_affinity" on a canary and enable proxy.coalesce_small_writes=true?

dana: Doing canary now. Will watch p95, host CPU, and kvcache.hit_rate_by_worker.

miguel: Also adding microbench in eng/runtime/bench/stream_coalesce_test.go to assert writev calls/request <= 3 for small streams.

deploy-bot: start canary: kernel-packer-kv-affinity-canary id=canary-513246A

dana: Canary 10m update: p95 down ~14ms, writev calls/request 1.9, kv hit_rate +2%. Good signal. Keeping watch for 30m.

lee: If stable, we'll roll config cluster-wide and follow up with selector scoring that counts kv_affinity. Also file PERF-1029 to remove one memcpy from tokenize_utf8.

dana: Will post final canary metrics in 30m.
